game.title: inFAMOUS 2
game.blurb: Open-world superhero action game set in New Marais, from Sucker Punch Productions, published by Sony Computer Entertainment, released 2011-06-07 on PlayStation 3. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters use the 34 story mission names on StrategyWiki's contents page, plus its side mission and collectible pages.

chapters.title: Leaving Empire City to Evolution
chapters.summary: Story missions 1 to 6 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Leaving Empire City, Breaking into New Marais, Forward Momentum, Lost and Found, Karma's a Bitch and Evolution.

chapters.title: Bertrand Takes the Stage to Powering Up Ascension Parish
chapters.summary: Story missions 7 to 13 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Bertrand Takes the Stage, Bomb Scare, Wolfe Hunt, Desperate Times, Storm's Coming, Torn and Powering Up Ascension Parish. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Sacrifice to Powering Up Flood Town
chapters.summary: Story missions 14 to 21 on the StrategyWiki contents page: The Sacrifice, Conduit, Not Human, Good gets Better, Stories Of The Past, Transferring Power, Storm the Fort, Joseph Bertrand the 3rd and Powering Up Flood Town. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Dunbar Beam to Powering Up Gas Works
chapters.summary: Story missions 22 to 27 on the StrategyWiki contents page: The Dunbar Beam, Burning Wells, Ray Field Energy, Rail Yard Intel, The Beast Draws Near and Powering Up Gas Works. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Forced Conduits to The Final Decision
chapters.summary: Story missions 28 to 34 on the StrategyWiki contents page: Forced Conduits, Easy Going, The Face of Change, Demons, Death Toll, The Final Piece and The Final Decision. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Good, Evil and Neutral Side Missions
chapters.summary: The good, evil and neutral side mission pages on the contents page.

chapters.title: Blast Shards, Dead Drops and Stunts
chapters.summary: Collecting Blast Shards and Dead Drops around New Marais, and performing stunts.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4671). PlayStation 3 only, so steam=None and the chapters come from StrategyWiki page names (swNames). StrategyWiki has the guide under "InFAMOUS 2" (the wiki capitalises the first letter) at completion stage 0; only its Table of Contents (about 2,400 characters) is written. Gameplay, Controls, Enemies, Powers, Walkthrough, the 34 story mission pages, the good, evil and neutral side mission pages, Blast Shards, Dead Drops, Stunts and Trophies are linked but not written. The story chapters use its mission names in contents order, from "Leaving Empire City" to "The Final Decision", broken after each "Powering Up" mission (Ascension Parish, Flood Town, Gas Works); that split is our own choice and the summaries are only placeholders built from the page names. RAWG keeps "inFAMOUS Festival of Blood" (2011-10-25) as an addition. infamous.fandom.com answers the API under "Infamous 2" (redirected from "inFAMOUS 2") with about 91 linked articles (places such as New Marais, Ascension Parish, Flood Town and Gas Works, characters and powers); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
